characterList.description: A middle-aged man with a beard, wearing a blue plaid shirt, a baseball cap with a white front panel and sunglasses with blue reflective lenses. He carries a backpack and two fishing rods on his back.
characterList.name: Eric

characterList.description: A woman with light brown hair tied in a ponytail, wearing a light blue t-shirt with a 'Montana' logo, sunglasses, and a green backpack.
characterList.name: Amy

characterList.description: A younger man wearing a blue t-shirt with a 'Wyoming' logo and a baseball cap.
characterList.name: Ryan

characterList.description: Appears briefly behind Eric, has grey hair and a grey beard, wears a white cap and a blue backpack.
characterList.name: Unknown Man

characterList.description: A group of 8-10 hikers, mostly young adults, hiking on the trail. Some are wearing backpacks.

characterList.description: Appears briefly in the final scene behind Eric with a pink tank top and dark sunglasses.

content_metadata.description: A humorous and relatable story of a 'fat guy' overcoming a challenging hike to enjoy the beauty and tranquility of Jade Lake.

qAndA.answer: Less than an hour and a half.
